text: Is the speaker being told this by multiple distinct people?
Is the repeated phrase spoken by a single person who is repeating it?
Is the repeated phrase being written rather than spoken?
Are these written messages all addressed to the sighing person?
Are the seven identical messages automated notifications?
Are the seven messages from the same sender?
Did the sender write the phrase seven separate times, intending each as a separate farewell?
Was the phrase copied and pasted, or duplicated by a technical/automated process, so the sender did not write it seven times intentionally?
Is the repetition caused by a single written message being displayed multiple times (e.g., on repeated lines or multiple screens/pages)?
Was the phrase written once by the sender, then transcribed or quoted seven times by someone else?
Are the seven lines actually distinct entries in a list, such as seven separate reviews, comments, or signatures by the same sender?
Is the sender a machine or program rather than a human being?
Is the sighing person being told this because they failed to meet the sender's expectations in a personal relationship?
Are the seven messages all written to the same recipient on different occasions over time?
Are the seven messages all written to the same recipient at the same time/occasion?
Are the seven messages addressed to seven different recipients?
Are the seven messages addressed to fewer than seven recipients (i.e., some recipients receive duplicates)?
Is the sighing person the only recipient, receiving the same message seven times?
Are there exactly two recipients receiving the messages?
Are the seven messages published publicly (visible to anyone) rather than sent privately?
Are the messages separate notes or letters left for the recipient in physical form?
Are the messages emails?
Are the messages text messages or chat messages?
Are the messages handwritten in a personal medium such as a diary, journal, or guestbook?
Are the messages the result of the sender writing on many copies of the same document/form (e.g., signing or annotating each page)?
Is the sender leaving these written messages at the scene of a breakup, such as on seven sticky notes around the house?
Are the messages written as captions or comments on a single shared photo or post?
Is the "writing" something like engraved text or a printed inscription that appears on seven identical items?
Are the seven lines the sender's words repeated in a written exchange where the recipient can see them all at once, such as a chat log?
